name: check_availability
description: Open consultation times, already in the doctor's local time. Call when they're open to booking, and again if they want a different day or time of day.

preferred_day.description: 'today', 'tomorrow', a weekday or YYYY-MM-DD, only if the doctor said one.

time_of_day.description: Their preferred part of the day, local time.

name: book_consult
description: Book the slot_id from check_availability, exactly as written, once the doctor has chosen it.

email.description: Only if none is on file or the doctor gave a different one.

name: send_booking_link
description: Email and WhatsApp the self-service booking link: nothing suits, they'd rather pick a time themselves, they're busy, or booking failed. Never for a trainee finishing more than three months from now (they get the app sign-up from the team instead).

name: mark_outcome
description: Record a call that didn't end in a booking; call once, just before ending. callback_requested: they asked to be rung back (pass callback_hours if they said when), or a trainee finishing more than three months away. not_interested: the doctor declined. not_a_gp: they enquired but aren't a GP. wrong_number: not the doctor asked for, or never enquired and isn't a doctor (a doctor who forgot the form is not a wrong number). already_booked: they already have a call booked.

callback_hours.description: Hours from now they asked to be rung back, if given.

name: end_call
description: Hang up. Pass your one sentence of thanks and goodbye as the message; it is spoken before the line drops, so do not say a goodbye separately.
